data.description: Write slop/BRANDING.md, the design brief for a new sub-site 'slop' whose aesthetic parodies low-effort AI-generated event fliers (reference: a 'TEEN TAKE OVER' park-party flier — purple/black/gold, graffiti-brush display type, every word styled differently, gold gradient numerals with a random superscript TH, layered hard drop shadows and white outlines, spray-splatter texture, clip-art crowns/stars/peace-signs/arrows, mushy AI-rendered crowd silhouettes and melting city skyline, semi-garbled text like 'BRING YO WHOLE CREW' and '4:30 UNTIL 8:00'). DECISION (human-approved, 2026-08-08): the page will be built in CSS/HTML, NOT as a raster image with an image map — image maps don't survive responsive scaling, and a code brief lets the brand-page skill regenerate the page. AI-generated raster images are licensed ONLY as decorative background layers (the pseudo-photographic parts CSS can't fake: crowd silhouettes, skyline, garbled park sign), referenced by absolute path /slop/… because relative CSS URLs break in the root build. Deliverable: slop/BRANDING.md only (folder may need creating); the index.html generation is a separate follow-up task. Format/quality bar: match the structure and rigor of memphis/BRANDING.md — named palette with tokens and contrast rules, type stack, texture/pattern recipes (SVG data URIs), text-treatment rules, composition rules, a 'what this is not' section (not vaporwave, not real graffiti design, not actual competent street-party design — it is AI's confused idea of one), and a page-application section. Must respect the sub-site authoring contract in project CLAUDE.md (Google Fonts @import with %3B-encoded semicolons, site-name-prefixed ids/keyframes/font names, etc.).

data.description: Render slop/BRANDING.md into slop/index.html using the brand-page skill (procedure at .claude/skills/brand-page/SKILL.md — read it in full; it is the authoritative workflow). Human invoked /brand-page on 2026-08-08 immediately after FA-14 landed the brief (commits 1d7cd4e, c967aaf). Scope: slop/index.html only (self-contained inline style/script, standalone page). The brief's §11 'Page application' describes the target page concretely and §11 'Build-contract constraints' restates the sub-site authoring contract — both must be honored, along with the brief's every-word law, gold-ramp recipe, garble lexicon, SVG clip-art data URIs, raster degradation rule (the three /slop/*.png images do NOT exist yet — the gradient stand-ins must carry the page), and own scroll container. Per the skill: do NOT commit (leave in working tree), do NOT touch root index.html/style.css/script.js, no external requests except the brief's named Google Fonts import. Out of scope: sites.config.json mapping, node build.js, generating raster images.
